subject: Workplace Skills
title: Trust Is the Foundation
description: A fast breakdown of Trust Is the Foundation for builders.

hook.text: Patrick Lencioni says the absence of trust is the first dysfunction of a team. Everything else fails without it.

buildup.text: Without trust, people won't take risks, share ideas, or admit mistakes. The team looks functional but underperforms.

discovery.text: Trust is built through consistency: do what you say, follow through on commitments, and show up reliably.

twist.text: Trust is built slowly but destroyed instantly. One broken promise erases months of consistent behavior.

climax.text: Under-promise and over-deliver. Make small commitments and keep every one. Trust accumulates from kept small promises.

punchline.text: Keep every small promise. Trust compounds from there.

quiz.question: How is trust built most effectively in teams?
options: Through team-building activities and social events
Through consistent follow-through on commitments, especially small ones
By sharing personal information to create vulnerability
